name: logseq
description: Logseq selects a platform and architecture update channel, disables downgrade, and enables auto-retrieval only for permitted production configuration; the application source does not establish SHA512 or Windows Authenticode enforcement.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
